blocks.text: This article provides information for managing Zscaler Digital Experience (ZDX) troubleshooting by using APIs. All APIs are rate limited. To learn more, see Understanding Rate Limiting.

blocks.heading: Start a Deep Trace for a Device

blocks.text: To start a deep tracing session on a device, send a POST request to the endpoint /devices/{deviceid}/deeptraces. Provide the following in the request:
A successful response returns code 200. To learn more, see Understanding Error Codes.

blocks.heading: Stop a Deep Trace for a Device

blocks.text: To stop a deep tracing session on a device, send a DELETE request to the endpoint /devices/{deviceid}/deeptraces. Provide the following in the request:
This deletes the deep tracing session and the associated data.

blocks.item: trace_id: The deep tracing ID that requires a stop.

blocks.text: A successful response returns code 200. To learn more, see Understanding Error Codes.

blocks.heading: Get the Deep Tracing Session Configuration
